title: Usage analytics
description: Product events and crash reports go to PostHog and Sentry. Message bodies, file paths, and secrets are not sent. You can turn this off at any time.
enabledHint: Covers funnels, retention, and crash reports. First-party video growth events follow the same switch.
notConfigured: This build has no PostHog or Sentry keys. Local funnel events still run for first-win UX.
configured: This build will send events when the switch is on.
installIdHint: Anonymous id shared with presence heartbeats.
